editor.variablesHint: Variable names injected at run time (all strings); reference them in prompts as double-braced input.<name>
editor.nodeIdInvalid: ID must be kebab-case and unique among nodes
editor.timeoutHint: Default 30s, max 24h; process group is killed on timeout
editor.scriptHint: stdout becomes node output; stdin receives {inputs, nodes} JSON; supports {{input.x}}/{{nodes.*.output}} templating
editor.codeBranchHint: Branch mode: the last non-empty stdout line is the branch label and must exactly match one of the options
editor.polishNoModel: Select a model for this node first
editor.polishEmpty: Write some prompt text before polishing
editor.httpBodyHint: Supports {{}} placeholders; Content-Type follows the body type unless set explicitly in headers
editor.httpFormHint: Form format: key=value joined with & (e.g. a=1&b={{input.b}}), supports {{}} placeholders
editor.httpTimeoutHint: Default 120s, max 10 minutes; first 64KB of the response body becomes node output
editor.httpAuthHint: Overrides same-name headers when injected; credentials support {{}} placeholders
editor.acs3Hint: Signs the full request per the Aliyun V3 signature scheme; injects <prefix>date / <prefix>signature-nonce / <prefix>content-sha256 (default x-acs-, editable); headers with this prefix plus host and content-type are signed; business headers (e.g. x-acs-action) go in the headers list with the prefix. Rewrite the prefix and algorithm as needed for other gateways
editor.httpRetriesHint: Retries on network failure or non-2xx (0-5 times, 0.5s interval)
editor.httpBinaryHint: "Pick file" snapshots the content: a copy is stored in the app data directory, immune to later moves/edits of the source (max 10MB; set an exact Content-Type header). Typing a path directly is reference mode (read at run time)
editor.httpBinaryPlaceholder: Pick a file to snapshot, or type a path to reference
editor.pickFileTooLarge: File exceeds the 10MB limit and cannot be snapshotted
editor.llmTimeoutHint: Default 180s, max 1 hour; covers all retries
editor.llmRetriesHint: Retries on call failure/timeout/parse failure (0-5 times, 0.5s interval; config errors are not retried)
editor.errorOutputHint: Used as the node output to continue downstream when retries are exhausted (run history marks the fallback reason)
editor.fileReadHint: Workspace directory only (relative or absolute, supports {{}} placeholders); utf-8 text (1MB max) becomes the node output
editor.notifyHint: Title/body support {{}} placeholders; sends a desktop notification at run time (delivery failure does not fail the flow)
editor.subflowHint: Output is the sub-workflow's final node output; its run records and messages belong to the sub-workflow itself
editor.subflowAsyncHint: The main flow continues immediately (receipt text only, no output to reference); the child runs independently in the background
editor.subflowNoCandidates: No referenceable workflows yet (save another workflow first)
editor.subflowInputsHint: Key = an input variable declared by the sub-workflow; value supports {{}} placeholders
editor.iterateModeHint: Repeat a series of tasks by setting the loop count and logic
editor.iterateBreakHint: Evaluated after each round; breaks when satisfied (while semantics); {{nodes.<this>.output}} refers to this round's sub-workflow output; exceeding the item limit fails the node (safety fuse)
editor.iterateCarryVariableHint: Shared across iterations: each round injects this variable into the sub-workflow with the previous round's output (Coze intermediate variable)
editor.iterateCountHint: Positive integer or {{}} placeholder; the sub-workflow runs once per 1..N
editor.iterateOutputHint: Item outputs are joined line by line as the node output; {{itemVariable}} and {{itemVariable}}Index are available inside the sub-workflow
editor.iterateItemsHint: JSON string array is split by items, otherwise by non-empty lines; each item runs the sub-workflow once
editor.iterateVariableHint: The current item is injected as this input variable of the sub-workflow
editor.iterateMaxItemsHint: Safety fuse (1-1000, default 100); exceeding it fails the node
editor.libraryQueryHint: Space-separated AND match over library text files (supports {{}} placeholders); output is file names + snippets; empty output on no hits (not a failure)
editor.libraryMaxResultsHint: At most N hit files returned (1-20, default 5); text files up to 1MB each
editor.jsonParseHint: Supports {{}} placeholders (typically an HTTP response body); parse failure or missing path fails the node
editor.jsonPathHint: Dot path (e.g. data.items[0].name); empty outputs the pretty-printed full JSON
editor.jsonArrayLinesHint: One item per line when the path hits an array (feeds the iterate node)
editor.jsonStringifyHint: Valid JSON object/array outputs compact normalized text; other text outputs an escaped JSON string literal — used to embed {{nodes.x.output}} safely into a JSON body
editor.intentListHint: Name = branch output channel (conditional edges attach intent names); descriptions help the model classify
editor.intentFallbackHint: Routed when the model output matches no intent; the node fails if unset
editor.condHint: Evaluated in order; all conditions in a branch must match. The branch name is its output channel (wire each branch on the canvas). Prefer this node for routing over branch modes inside AI/code nodes
editor.condFallbackHint: Taken when no branch matches; empty ends the flow
editor.fileWriteHint: Workspace directory only (supports {{}} placeholders); append/overwrite modes with auto-created directories; requires full access (test runs exempt)
editor.docExtractHint: PDF / Word (docx) / plain text → text output (workspace only, supports {{}} placeholders)
editor.imagePromptHint: Supports {{}} placeholders; the image is stored in the app data directory; output is the absolute file path
editor.comfyNoProvider: No ComfyUI provider yet — add one in AI Providers first
editor.comfyWorkflowHint: Paste the ComfyUI export (API format); use {{prompt}}/{{width}}/{{height}}/{{seed}} placeholders; upstream {{}} variables supported
editor.iterateConcurrencyHint: 1-5 (parallel within batches, serial between); sub-workflows receive both {{itemVariable}} and {{itemVariable}}Index
editor.iterateOnErrorContinue: Skip failed items (fails only if all fail)
editor.testNodeNoVars: This node references no variables; run directly
editor.vectorHint: Re-ingesting the same collection+entry deletes then inserts (idempotent); collections namespace searches
editor.vectorModelHint: Pick an embedding model (e.g. text-embedding-3-small); ingest and search must use the same model (dimensions differ otherwise)
editor.vectorTextHint: Supports {{}} placeholders, typically fed by doc extract / file read; chunked then embedded
editor.vectorSearchHint: Empty searches all collections; output is hit entries with scores, feeds AI nodes as context
editor.dbSqliteHint: Workspace directory only ({{}} placeholders); auto-created when missing
editor.dbSqlHint: {{}} placeholders at your own risk; prefer parameters: ? for SQLite/MySQL/SqlServer, $1 for PostgreSQL, :1 for Oracle; connect/query timeout 15s/60s
editor.dbParamsHint: One per SQL placeholder in order; press Enter or comma to commit each item as a tag (paste comma-separated to add several at once), click × to remove; {{}} supported, bound via driver parameterization
editor.dbMaxRowsHint: Max SELECT rows returned (default 1000, up to 100k for ETL; truncate with a hint beyond — paginate with LIMIT/OFFSET for full extracts); the output byte budget follows this
editor.dbBatchHint: A JSON 2-D param array (e.g. [[1,"a"],[2,"b"]], {{}} supported); when set the SQL is a single-row template bound per row inside a transaction, rolled back on any failure, outputting total affectedRows
editor.excelReadHint: xlsx file (workspace only, {{}} supported); first row as keys to JSON row array
editor.excelWriteHint: writes xlsx to workspace (full access); rows must be a JSON array ({{}}), keys as header
editor.mergeHint: Combines upstream outputs into one ({{nodes.a.output}} and {{nodes.b.output}}); waits for all incoming edges
editor.webhookHint: Sent alongside the desktop notification (failures don't fail the flow); POSTs title+body in the platform text-message format
editor.addNodeSearch: Search nodes by name or function
